test_adjusted_rand_score: test the adjusted_rand_score function to measure agreement between two clusterings adjusted for chance
test_adjusted_mutual_info_score: test the adjusted_mutual_info_score function to compute mutual information between clusterings adjusted for chance
test_v_measure_score: test the v_measure_score function to compute the harmonic mean of homogeneity and completeness
test_contingency_matrix: test the contingency_matrix function to build a contingency matrix from true and predicted cluster labels
test_fowlkes_mallows_score: test the fowlkes_mallows_score function to compute the geometric mean of precision and recall for pairs
